post.description:
Answer a single-turn RAG query with the LIVE pipeline.

Config resolution is REAL (pins echoed in ``result.system_version``,
incl. ``config_sha256``); the chain is policy_router → query_rewrite →
embed → retrieve → rerank → assemble → prompt → generate → guardrails →
cite, with clients pulled from ``app.state`` and spans/timings recorded
OUTSIDE the pure stages. The ``result`` block validates verbatim against
eval's rag_query_output v1.1.0.

422.description: Request validation failed (e.g. malformed pipeline_config ref).

500.description: Packaged config artifact failed integrity verification.

502.description: An upstream dependency failed: OpenSearch search failure, or a non-throttle Bedrock error. The body names the dependency.

503.description: Bedrock throttling persisted past the bounded retry budget. Transient — retry after the Retry-After interval.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying the query.
